contract: POST /api/sessions/batch/delete. Admin batch deletion validates a nonempty session-ID array, deletes selected history and closes matching open sessions; malformed arrays return 400 and non-admins 403.
exceptions: Mapping only: no tests executed in this invocation. Historical evidence is retained for provenance and does not verify this checkout; named tests are assertion leads, not exhaustive proof of every stated requirement.
force is not applicable: batch delete has no force/hard mode; absent ids are ignored and a repeat answers 200.

invariants.contract: POST /api/sessions/batch/delete as an admin with a non-empty array of session uuids answers 200 with an empty body, removes exactly those stored rows and any matching open session without an event, and keeps the other rows; a missing, empty, non-array or non-uuid sessions body answers 400, a non-admin 403 (checked first) and an unauthenticated caller 401, changing nothing.
exceptions: Assertion leads only; missing normal/error/edge and state-transition proof must be supplied by the owning packet.
